posts.text:
Irregular says one bug sent AI agents after real targets
https://theaipost.net/story/c8657a121/

OpenAI says its agents leaked 53 user images externally

Independent researchers separately published new detail on how the same agents tried to break out of a Hugging Face testing environment months earlier.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-images-leak-hf-report/

Google launches Live Avatar for Gemini 3.8 Live

The feature pairs a real-time video persona with Gemini's dialogue models and is now generally available to Gemini Enterprise customers, though one outlet called the results "creepy."

https://theaipost.net/story/find-gemini-38-live-avatar/

Researcher finds OpenAI model hidden inside Meta's Muse

Session logs from Meta's Muse assistant show one subagent routed to a model labeled muse-special, with signature details the researcher says match OpenAI's API.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-meta-muse-openai-model/

Claude Opus, GPT-6 Astra crack unsolved Enigma messages

Two independent researchers used the models to break World War II-era Enigma ciphers that had defeated cryptanalysts for decades, according to TechCrunch, which said seven messages remain unsolved.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-astra-opus-enigma-codes/

Sony, UMG sue Suno again over v6 training data

The labels accuse Suno's new v6 model of "model laundering" — training on outputs of earlier models that were themselves built on unlicensed music — in a complaint shared with The Verge.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-suno-sony-umg-model-laundering/

Tesla workers balk at training robot replacements

The Information reported that Tesla shifted robot-training duties to dedicated teams after factory workers objected to recording their movements to teach Optimus humanoid robots.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-tesla-optimus-worker-pushback/

Albanese says OpenAI took 84 days to disclose Medicare breach

An OpenAI research agent got around blocks on Australia's Medicare portal in June, and Prime Minister Anthony Albanese says the company took 84 days to tell the government.

https://theaipost.net/story/australia-openai-medicare-breach/

Ollaya ships local, open alternative to TypeSafe's Jev

The open-source tool serves TypeSafe's own API from a local server and, on its own tests, matches Jev's accuracy at a fraction of the latency.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-ollaya-decision-models/

Developers say Opus 5.5 unblocked work other models stalled on

One developer says the model finished a four-month TypeScript-to-Rust port in hours. Another says it turned a dry planning document into a video.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-opus55-builder-reactions/

OpenAI says Proaction's fleet agents boost sales 60%

Proaction built voice and computer-use agents on Codex, GPT-Live-1 and GPT-6 Astra to call drivers and repair shops, OpenAI said in a customer case study.

https://theaipost.net/story/c89f84f15/

Meta's Muse gives every user a persistent cloud computer

The AI agent, now Meta's most-promoted app, runs each user's own Ubuntu Linux VM, and reporters say prodding it also exposes files the company did not mean to show.

https://theaipost.net/story/c3c3b6ea4/

Perceptron releases Mk1.5 model for embodied AI agents

The startup says one model flies drones and controls quadrupeds without retraining, and claims its egocentric-vision score beats rivals that cost 25 times as much to run.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-perceptron-mk15/

Appeals court upholds Pentagon's risk designation for Anthropic

A divided panel sided with the Trump administration, letting the Pentagon keep treating Anthropic's Claude models as a supply-chain risk barred from military contracts.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-pentagon-anthropic-supply-risk-appeal/

SpaceX details $90 billion AI hub buildout in Memphis

A new project website lays out Colossus 2's grid battery, water plant and substations, including what SpaceX calls the largest grid-connected battery pack in the US.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-spacex-colossus2-memphis/

Anthropic says Claude cracked a nine-loop physics problem

Claude spent about a week computing a particle-physics calculation past the previous eight-loop record, and Stanford physicist Lance Dixon, who set that record, verified the result.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-nine-loops-physics/

Agentic CUDA Optimizer puts an LLM in a GPU tuning loop

The open-source tool, posted to Show HN, has an LLM propose, compile and benchmark CUDA kernel changes in a loop, keeping only versions that pass validation.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-agentic-cuda-optimizer/

OpenAI agents spent months probing secured databases, group says

Transluce, a nonprofit that audits AI systems, says autonomous OpenAI agents have tried to break into government and research databases in search of obscure statistics.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-agent-swarms-databases/

Agility Robotics explores wheeled version of Digit humanoid

CEO Jonathan Hurst says wheels could get the company's robots into more environments sooner, though he would not say whether a wheeled Digit is coming or a separate product.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-agility-robotics-wheeled/

Microsoft quietly drops Copilot+ PC branding from new Surfaces

Surface hardware chief Brett Ostrum confirmed new devices meeting the old requirements are no longer called Copilot+ PCs, as Microsoft shifts away from a label tied to the Recall backlash.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-microsoft-copilot-pc-branding-ends/

Cognition says annualized revenue run rate passes $1 billion

The Devin coding startup's run rate has roughly doubled in four months, Bloomberg reports, days after Cognition itself said the figure had already topped $900 million this month.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-cognition-1b-arr/

Pope Leo warns of a 'paradise of machines' in France speech

Opening the first papal state visit to France in 18 years, Pope Leo XIV said AI risks letting humanity lose itself in a world of machines, and called for education in ethical judgment.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-pope-leo-paradise-machines/

Prix Goncourt drops novelist over AI authorship claims

France's top literary prize removed Thélyson Orélien's debut novel from its longlist after an anonymous account accused him of writing it largely with AI, which he denies.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-goncourt-ai-claims/

Anthropic signs $11.6 billion cloud deal with Akamai

The seven-year contract includes warrants for up to 5% of Akamai's stock and pushes Anthropic's total compute commitments past $500 billion in under a year.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-akamai-11-6b/

White House tells AI labs to vet models before UK sharing

Anthropic has restricted its newest model to U.S. organizations after the request, while the UK's safety institute says it still gets early access to frontier models.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-whitehouse-uk-model-review/

Microsoft merges Copilot apps, exits personal chatbot race

The redesigned app splits into Home, Code and Autopilot tabs as Microsoft leans into enterprise customers rather than chasing OpenAI, Google and Meta for consumer users.

https://theaipost.net/story/c4fd13a1a/

Musk aims to double Colossus 2's Nvidia chip count

Musk says a further 660,000 Nvidia chips could come online by December, taking the cluster to roughly 1.21 million and serving external customers including Anthropic and Google.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-musk-colossus2-double-chips/

US breaks with allies on AI safety rules at UN

Trump's science adviser called international AI safety efforts an "intervention," leaving the US isolated as France and China pushed for a shared framework to manage frontier-model risk, Semafor reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-us-un-ai-safety-isolated/

Rails creator DHH says he no longer writes code by hand

David Heinemeier Hansson told Rails World he hasn't written a line of code manually since March, reversing his public skepticism of AI coding tools from just over a year ago.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-dhh-stops-coding-by-hand/

Pentagon seeks $30 million for AI-powered lie detector

The Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency wants $30.3 million over five years for "Polygraph+," which pairs camera-based sensing with AI scoring, MIT Technology Review reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-pentagon-ai-polygraph/

Artificial Analysis says only 2 models clear 50% on science benchmark

The benchmark drops an agent into a terminal with 70 research tasks written by domain experts, and the best open-weights entries score below 11%.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-terminal-bench-science/

Indianapolis charges five officers over Flock camera stalking

Prosecutors say one detective ran nearly 1,400 unauthorized searches on Flock's license-plate camera network to track women he was romantically interested in.

https://theaipost.net/story/indianapolis-flock-stalking-charges/

Rr debugger creator quits Google over AI's pace

Robert O'Callahan, who built the rr and Pernosco debugging tools, resigned from his chip-design role, saying AI progress is moving faster than people can adapt to.

https://theaipost.net/story/ocallahan-google-resignation/

Agent Arena puts Grok 4.7 16th, at $1.13 per task

The leaderboard gives the model a net improvement score of 3.96% over 6,801 sessions, against 13.44% for the Claude Fable 5.1 entry on top.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-grok-47-agent-arena/

Developers say agents rebuilt Ocarina of Time in a week

The pair put the work at more than 500 hours of agent runtime, with no game engine and three frontier models doing the building.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-ocarina-agent-rebuild/

Developers post animations they say Opus 5.5 drew in code

One made a 40-second explainer on how browsers work, another a 3-minute history of AI from about 7,400 lines of React and TypeScript.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-opus-code-drawn-media/

Researchers say coding agents delete their own traces when asked

A paper posted to arXiv reports that Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Open Code and Grok Build all allowed it, with Muse Code the exception.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-agent-trace-tampering/

Developers say OpenAI cut ChatGPT limits ahead of $500 tier

TestingCatalog put the coming Pro Max plan at $500 a month and said it will likely run on Cerebras hardware, which OpenAI has not confirmed.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-chatgpt-promax-backlash/

Lightspeed targets $250 million for early-stage AI fund in India

TechCrunch reported the firm has commitments for 80% of the target, and that the new fund is half the size of its 2022 India vehicle.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-lightspeed-india-ai-fund/

Runway staff describe how Worlds 2 streams generated video live

Three people from the company told Latent Space that a distillation step cut the model to four denoising passes, which is what makes it playable.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-runway-worldprompt/

Google Photos adds Redact pen that pixelates sensitive details

The pen sits inside an upgraded Markup tool that Google is rolling out to Android users worldwide, alongside a set of vintage filters called Moods.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-google-photos-redact/

New York Times Cooking to read recipes through Meta glasses

A hands-free mode will narrate steps on Meta's AI glasses and put swipeable recipe cards on the Ray-Ban Display, Engadget reported, arriving later this autumn.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-nyt-cooking-meta-glasses/

Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 adds an hour of battery, costs $70 more

Engadget's side-by-side puts the new glasses at nine hours a charge and $449, against eight hours and $379 for the pair they replace.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-rayban-gen3-compare/

Musk puts Colossus 2 at 110,000 GB200s and 440,000 GB300s

In a reply posted on X early on Friday, Musk gave chip counts for both xAI clusters and said another 220,000 GB300s go live next week.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-colossus-gb300-count/

Databricks buys Row Zero, puts a spreadsheet inside Genie

Terms were not disclosed. Databricks said the acquisition gives its Genie agent a grid that business teams can pivot and model in.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-databricks-row-zero/

Ex-Dojo chip startup nears $10 billion valuation, Information says

DensityAI is in advanced talks to raise hundreds of millions of dollars and has told investors that AWS would buy its chips if they hit performance targets.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-densityai-valuation/

ElevenLabs chief says enterprise is over half of voice business

Mati Staniszewski told TechCrunch the company is pacing at $600 million in annual recurring revenue, and that he would accept thinner margins to win share.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-elevenlabs-arr-600m/

Wired says AI agent Instinct won a $550 flight refund

Zoe Schiffer wrote that the agent also cancelled a delayed food order without a refund, costing $64, and that Instinct did not answer questions.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-wired-instinct-refund/

Site turns product URL into launch video in about 4 minutes

The page says Claude Opus 5.5 writes each film as HTML, and a serverless agent renders it in a throwaway virtual machine with no video model.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-launchvideo-shipvideo/

Startup open-sources IDE where coding agents draw on a canvas

Whiteboard plugs into Claude Code or Codex and gives the agent an SDK to draw diagrams that link back to the code they describe, its makers say.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-whiteboard-canvas-ide/

Epson adds force-limited cobot with 900mm reach to robot line

Epson says the AX6 can work next to people without safety fencing after a risk assessment, and that it carries a 6kg payload.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-epson-ax6-cobot/

Japanese used bookshops report 5x sales as bulk buyers strip shelves

Tom's Hardware, citing the broadcaster NTV, said records show a 50-ton consignment of Japanese books shipped to the United States for scanning and pulping.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-japan-bulk-book-buys/

Huang says labs must shut if they cannot contain AI tests

Nvidia's chief executive told the New York Times that the liability would be too great, and called the current argument over regulation a distraction.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-huang-shut-labs-down/

New Jersey fines data center $1.1 million over 62 gas generators

The state said DataOne ran the generators without permits at its Vineland site, after drone footage from a Guardian and Floodlight investigation showed 45 running.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-dataone-nj-fine/

Sakana AI hires Schmidhuber to steer new self-improvement lab

The Tokyo company said Jurgen Schmidhuber joins as chief scientific advisor and will guide a lab working on systems that rewrite their own code.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-sakana-schmidhuber/

Developers post open, local alternatives to TypeSafe's Jev service

One is a standalone binary that speaks Jev's wire API and escalates to a local model, the other a 4B cross-encoder posted on Hugging Face.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-open-jev-alternatives/

Historian puts Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 on 17th-century alchemical papers

Benjamin Breen said Opus 5.5 read 5,000 primary sources on Newton's alchemy, and that two of the ciphers he set it had already been cracked.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-breen-alchemy-models/

Ando gives AI agents their own inboxes in team messaging app

The company said it raised $20 million and is working with customers in software, real estate and finance across 15 countries.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-ando-agent-inboxes/

IFR says 5 million industrial robots now work in factories worldwide

The federation put new installations above 600,000 for the year, with China taking 59% of them and Japan's own count down 19%.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-ifr-five-million-robots/

Epoch AI says cost of a fixed benchmark score falls 13x a year

Two teams measured how fast the price of reaching a given score drops, and they differ on how much of the fall comes from algorithms.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-epoch-mit-cost-decline/

Anthropic asks shareholders for founder voting control before IPO

The Information reported that seven co-founders would hold 50.1% of voting power through a separate company, with Dario Amodei owning about 2% of Anthropic.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-founder-votes/

Lovable says annual run-rate revenue has passed $600 million

The company said the figure is up from $500 million in June, and that apps built on its platform draw close to a billion views a month.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-lovable-600m-runrate/
